# Detached house for sale

> Stan Bradbury is delighted to bring to the market a charming four-bedroom detached home on a half an acre Located in the peaceful village of Ballykeeran, just a 4km from Athlone town centre, and less than 3kn from Glasson, this spacious four-bedroom home offers excellent family accommodation together with generous grounds and superb outdoor storage facilities.

- Lokalita: Ballykeeran, Athlone East
